hero.traditionTitle: The Living Tradition of the Village
hero.traditionDescription1: The beauty of village life — where tradition, work, and joy move together.
hero.traditionDescription2: The bullock cart symbolizes sustainable living and agricultural roots, while children running beside it represent freedom, unity, and a joyful childhood.
hero.traditionDescription3: Villages teach us respect for nature, strong family bonds, and a life balanced with simplicity. They are not just places to live, but foundations of culture, values, and humanity.
